description.zh: ACR企业版实例信息。
description.en: Information about the ACR Enterprise instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例的域名。默认为相应实例的所有域名。支持指定个别域名，多个以半角逗号分隔。
description.en: The domain names of the ACR Enterprise instance. By default, this includes all domain names for the instance. You can specify one or more domain names, separated by commas.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the ACR Enterprise instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例的名称。
description.en: The name of the ACR Enterprise instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例所属地域。
description.en: The region of the ACR Enterprise instance.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence]().

description.zh: 指定新的容器组配置信息。
description.en: Specifies the new container group configuration.

description.zh: 容器启动参数。最多10个。
description.en: The startup arguments for the container. You can specify up to 10 arguments.

description.zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个，单个命令支持256个字符。
description.en: The startup command for the container. You can specify up to 20 commands. Each command can be up to 256 characters in length.

description.zh: 容器vCPU大小。
description.en: The vCPU size of the container.

description.zh: 容器的环境变量信息列表。
description.en: The list of environment variables for the container.

description.zh: 指定容器使用的GPU个数。
description.en: The number of GPUs for the container.

description.zh: 容器镜像。
description.en: The container image.

description.zh:
镜像拉取策略。取值范围：

- Always：总是拉取。每次都拉取镜像。
- IfNotPresent：按需拉取。优先使用本地镜像，本地没有镜像时则拉取镜像。
- Never：从不拉取。使用本地镜像，不拉取镜像。
description.en:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: Always pulls the image.

- IfNotPresent: Pulls the image only if it is not present locally.

- Never: Never pulls the image. Uses the local image.

description.zh: 使用命令行方式设置postStart回调函数时，在容器内执行的命令。
description.en: The command to run in the container when you use the command line to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，接收HTTP Get请求的主机地址。
description.en: The host address that receives the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 生成的http请求头中，有效的http请求头信息集合。
description.en: The collection of valid HTTP request headers in the generated HTTP request.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。
description.en: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检查的端口号。
description.en: The port for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。
description.en: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用TCP Socket方式设置postStart回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的主机地址。
description.en: The host address for the TCP socket check when you use a TCP Socket to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用TCPSocket方式设置postStart回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的端口。
description.en: The port for the TCP socket check when you use a TCPSocket to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用命令行方式设置preStop回调函数时，在容器内执行的命令。
description.en: The command to run in the container when you use the command line to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，接收HTTP Get请求的主机地址。
description.en: The host address that receives the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 生成的http请求头信息。
description.en: The generated HTTP request header information.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。
description.en: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的端口号。
description.en: The port for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
description.en:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

description.zh: 使用TCP Socket方式设置preStop回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的主机地址。
description.en: The host address for the TCP socket check when you use a TCP Socket to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用TCPSocket方式设置preStop回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的端口。
description.en: The port for the TCP socket check when you use a TCPSocket to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 容器内检测命令。
description.en: The command to run for the check in the container.

description.zh: 从上次检查成功后认定检查失败的检查次数阈值（必须是连续失败）。默认为3次。
description.en: The number of consecutive failed checks required to determine that the check has failed after a success. The default is 3.

description.zh: HttpGet检测的路径。
description.en: The path for the HttpGet check.

description.zh: HttpGet检测的端口号。
description.en: The port for the HttpGet check.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
description.en:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request for a health check. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

description.zh: 检查开始执行的时间。以容器启动完成为起点开始计算。
description.en: The time when the check starts. The time is calculated from when the container starts.

description.zh: 检查执行的周期。默认为10秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The interval at which the check is performed. The default is 10 seconds. The minimum is 1 second.

description.zh: 从上次检查失败后重新认定检查成功的检查次数阈值（必须是连续成功）。默认为1次，当前必须为1次。
description.en: The number of consecutive successful checks required to determine that the check is successful after a failure. The default is 1. The value must be 1.

description.zh: TcpSocket检测的端口。
description.en: The port for the TcpSocket check.

description.zh: 检查超时的时间。默认为1秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The timeout period for the check. The default is 1 second. The minimum is 1 second.

description.zh: 容器内存大小。
description.en: The memory size of the container.

description.zh: 容器名称。
description.en: The name of the container.

description.zh: 容器端口号。取值范围：1~65535
description.en: The container port. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

description.zh: 容器内检测的命令。
description.en: The command to run for the check in the container.

description.zh: 从上次检查成功后认定检查失败的检查次数阈值（必须是连续失败）。默认为3次。
description.en: The number of consecutive failed checks required to determine that the check has failed after a success. The default is 3.

description.zh: HttpGet检测的路径。
description.en: The path for the HttpGet check.

description.zh: HttpGet检测的端口号。
description.en: The port for the HttpGet check.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
description.en:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request for a health check. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

description.zh: 检查开始执行的时间，以容器启动完成为起点计算。
description.en: The time when the check starts. The time is calculated from when the container starts.

description.zh: 检查执行的周期，默认为10秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The interval at which the check is performed. The default is 10 seconds. The minimum is 1 second.

description.zh: 从上次检查失败后重新认定检查成功的检查次数阈值（必须是连续成功），默认为1。
description.en: The number of consecutive successful checks required to determine that the check is successful after a failure. The default is 1.

description.zh: TcpSocket检测的端口。
description.en: The port for the TcpSocket check.

description.zh: 检查超时的时间。默认为1秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The timeout period for the check. The default is 1 second. The minimum is 1 second.

description.zh:
为容器内的进程授予某些特定的权限。目前仅支持配置为NET\_ADMIN和NET\_RAW。

> NET_RAW默认不支持，需提交工单申请。
description.en:
Grants specific permissions to processes in the container. Currently, only NET\_ADMIN and NET\_RAW are supported.

> NET\_RAW is not supported by default. To use it, submit a ticket.

description.zh: 是否只读根文件系统。取值目前仅支持：true。
description.en: Indicates whether the root file system is read-only. Currently, only \`true\` is supported.

description.zh: 用于运行容器进程入口点的UID。
description.en: The UID used to run the entry point of the container process.

description.zh: 此容器是否应在容器运行时为标准输入分配缓冲区。如果未设置，则容器中标准输入的读取值将导致EOF。默认为false。
description.en: Indicates whether to allocate a buffer for standard input in the container runtime. If not set, reading from standard input in the container results in an End-Of-File (EOF). The default is false.

description.zh: 当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中保持开启状态。如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态。
description.en: When standard input is true, the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions. If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts and is empty until the first client attaches to standard input. It then remains open to receive data until the client disconnects. At that point, standard input is closed and remains closed until the container restarts.

description.zh: 是否开启交互。默认为false，如果Command为/bin/bash类型，需要设置为true。
description.en: Indicates whether to enable interaction. The default is false. If the Command is of the /bin/bash type, set this to true.

description.zh: 容器的数据卷信息列表。
description.en: The list of volumes to mount to the container.

description.zh: 容器工作目录。
description.en: The working directory of the container.

description.zh: 指定需要更新的ECI实例ID，即容器组ID。
description.en: The ID of the ECI instance that you want to update. This is the container group ID.

description.zh: 实例级别（容器组）的vCPU数。
description.en: The number of vCPUs for the instance (container group).

description.zh: DNS服务器的IP地址列表。
description.en: The list of IP addresses of DNS servers.

description.zh: DNS配置信息。
description.en: The DNS configuration information.

description.zh: DNS配置的选项变量名。
description.en: The name of the option variable for the DNS configuration.

description.zh: DNS配置的选项变量值。
description.en: The value of the option variable for the DNS configuration.

description.zh: DNS搜索域列表。
description.en: The list of DNS search domains.

description.zh: 镜像仓库凭证信息列表。
description.en: A list of image repository credentials.

description.zh: 镜像仓库密码。
description.en: The password for the image repository.

description.zh: 不带`http://`或`https://`前缀的镜像仓库地址。
description.en: The address of the image repository without the `http://` or `https://` prefix.

description.zh: 镜像仓库用户名。
description.en: The username for the image repository.

description.zh: 指定新的Init容器信息。
description.en: Specifies the new Init container information.

description.zh: Init容器启动参数。
description.en: The startup arguments for the init container.

description.zh: Init容器指令。
description.en: The command for the init container.

description.zh: Init容器vCPU大小。
description.en: The number of vCPUs for the init container.

description.zh: 容器的环境变量信息列表。
description.en: The environment variables of the container.

description.zh: 指定Init容器使用的GPU个数。
description.en: The number of GPUs for the init container.

description.zh: Init容器镜像。
description.en: The container image for the init container.

description.zh:
镜像拉取策略。取值范围：

- Always：总是拉取。每次都拉取镜像。
- IfNotPresent：按需拉取。优先使用本地镜像，本地没有镜像时则拉取镜像。
- Never：从不拉取。使用本地镜像，不拉取镜像。
description.en:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: The image is always pulled.

- IfNotPresent: The local image is used first. If the image is not available locally, it is pulled.

- Never: The image is never pulled. Only the local image is used.

description.zh: Init容器内存大小。
description.en: The memory size of the init container.

description.zh: Init容器名称。
description.en: The name of the init container.

description.zh: 端口号。取值范围：1~65535。
description.en: The port number. The valid range is 1 to 65535.

description.zh:
为容器内的进程授予某些特定的权限。目前仅支持配置为NET\_ADMIN和NET\_RAW。

> NET_RAW默认不支持，需提交工单申请。
description.en:
Grants specific permissions to processes in the container. Only NET\_ADMIN and NET\_RAW are supported.

> NET\_RAW is not supported by default. Submit a ticket to request this permission.

description.zh: 容器运行的根文件系统是否为只读。目前仅支持配置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. The only valid value is \`true\`.

description.zh: 设置运行容器的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID to run the container.

description.zh: 此容器是否应在容器运行时为标准输入分配缓冲区。如果未设置，则容器中标准输入的读取值将导致EOF。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to allocate a buffer for the container's standard input. If not set, reading from standard input returns an End-of-File (EOF). The default is false.

description.zh: 当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中保持开启状态。如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态。
description.en: When standard input is enabled, the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions. If you set StdinOnce to true, the standard input is opened when the container starts. The stream is empty until the first client attaches. It then accepts data until the client disconnects. After the client disconnects, the stream is closed and remains closed until the container is restarted.

description.zh: 是否开启交互。默认为false，如果Command为/bin/bash类型时，需要设置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable interaction. The default value is false. If Command is set to /bin/bash, set this parameter to true.

description.zh: 挂载数据卷信息列表。
description.en: The list of volume mounts.

description.zh: Init容器工作目录。
description.en: The working directory of the init container.

description.zh: 实例级别的（容器组）的内存数。单位为GiB。
description.en: The memory size for the instance (container group). Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region.

description.zh: 所属资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
实例重启策略。取值范围：

- Always：总是重启
- Never：从不重启
- OnFailure：失败时重启
description.en:
The restart policy of the instance. Valid values:

- Always: Always restarts the instance.

- Never: Never restarts the instance.

- OnFailure: Restarts the instance upon failure.

description.zh: 实例绑定的标签列表。
description.en: The list of tags to attach to the instance.

description.zh: 标签键。
description.en: The tag key.

description.zh: 标签值。
description.en: The tag value.

description.zh:
更新类型。取值范围：

- RenewUpdate：全量更新，更新时需填写相关的所有参数。如果参数是一个List，不支持单独更新某个item，如果参数是一个结构体，不支持单独更新某个内部成员。
- IncrementalUpdate：增量更新，更新时可以只填某一需要更新的参数，其它相关参数保持原有不变。

默认为RenewUpdate。
description.en:
The update type. Valid values:

- RenewUpdate: A full update. You must specify all related parameters. You cannot update individual items in a list or individual members in a struct.

- IncrementalUpdate: An incremental update. You can specify only the parameters that you want to update. Unspecified parameters remain unchanged.

The default is RenewUpdate.

description.zh: 数据卷列表。
description.en: The list of volumes.

description.zh: ConfigFile数据卷对应的配置文件信息。
description.en: The configuration file information for the ConfigFile volume.

description.zh: EmptyDir数据卷的存储媒介，默认为空，使用node文件系统；支持配置为Memory，表示使用内存。
description.en: The storage medium of the EmptyDir volume. The default is an empty string, which means that the node's file system is used. You can set this to Memory to use memory.

description.zh: EmptyDir数据卷的大小。取值请带上单位，建议使用Gi或Mi。
description.en: The size of the EmptyDir volume. Specify the unit for the value, such as Gi or Mi.

description.zh:
使用FlexVolume插件挂载数据卷时的驱动类型。取值范围如下：

- alicloud/disk：挂载云盘。
- alicloud/nas：挂载NAS。
- alicloud/oss：挂载OSS。
description.en:
The driver type when you use a FlexVolume plug-in to mount a volume. Valid values:

- alicloud/disk: Mounts a disk.

- alicloud/nas: Mounts a NAS file system.

- alicloud/oss: Mounts an OSS bucket.

description.zh: 使用FlexVolume插件挂载云盘时，云盘的文件系统类型。支持的类型包括ext4、ext3、xfs、vfat。默认为ext4。
description.en: The file system type of the disk when you use a FlexVolume plug-in to mount the disk. Valid values include ext4, ext3, xfs, and vfat. The default value is ext4.

description.zh: FlexVolume对象选项列表。为KV形式，采用JSON传递。例如通过FlexVolume挂载云盘时，Options表示云盘的配置参数。更多信息，请参见[数据卷概述](~~90672~~)。
description.en: The list of FlexVolume options. The options are key-value pairs in JSON format. For example, when you mount a disk using FlexVolume, Options specifies the configuration parameters of the disk. For more information, see [Volume overview]().

description.zh:
HostPath数据卷在宿主机上的路径。

> 该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The path of the HostPath volume on the host.

> This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh:
HostPath数据卷的类型。取值范围：

 - Directory：目录。
- File：文件。

> 该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The type of the HostPath volume. Valid values:

- Directory: a directory.

- File: a file.

> This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh: NFS数据卷要挂载的路径。
description.en: The path to mount on the NFS volume.

description.zh:
NFS数据卷的读取权限。取值范围：

- true：NFS Volume具有只读权限。
- false：NFS Volume具有可读可写权限。
description.en:
The read-only permission for the NFS volume. Valid values:

- true: The NFS volume is read-only.

- false: The NFS volume is read-write.

description.zh: NFS数据卷的挂载点地址。
description.en: The address of the NFS mount target.

description.zh: 数据卷名称。
description.en: The name of the volume.

description.zh:
数据卷类型。取值范围：

- EmptyDirVolume：EmptyDir类型的数据卷，表示临时目录。
- ConfigFileVolume：ConfigFile类型的数据卷，表示配置文件。
- NFSVolume：NFS类型的数据卷，表示网络文件系统，例如NAS。
- FlexVolume：使用FlexVolume插件扩展存储类型，支持挂载云盘、NAS和OSS。
- HostPathVolume：HostPath类型的数据卷，表示宿主机上的文件或目录。该取值暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The type of the volume. Valid values:

- EmptyDirVolume: An EmptyDir volume. This is a temporary directory.

- ConfigFileVolume: A ConfigFile volume. This is a configuration file.

- NFSVolume: An NFS volume. This is a network file system, such as a Network Attached Storage (NAS) system.

- FlexVolume: A FlexVolume plug-in to extend the storage type. You can use it to mount disks, NAS, and Object Storage Service (OSS).

- HostPathVolume: A HostPath volume. This is a file or directory on the host. This value is not yet available.

descriptions.zh:
- 仅支持处于启动中（Pending）或运行中（Running）状态的ECI实例进行更新。更新操作后，ECI实例状态将变更为更新中（Updating）。
- 更新RestartPolicy配置为Never的ECI实例可能会有容器Failed的风险，请慎重更新。
descriptions.en:
- You can update only Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances that are in the Pending or Running state. After the update, the instance status changes to Updating.

- Updating an ECI instance with a RestartPolicy of Never may cause containers to fail. Proceed with caution.
